posts.title: Welcome to SendToDesk
posts.excerpt: Send passport photos and scans from Android to Windows over Wi‑Fi.
posts.body:
Why SendToDesk?

Files stay on your local Wi‑Fi. No cloud upload for everyday transfers.

  • Passport photo tools
  • Document scan to PDF
  • Compress to KB limits

Download Windows

posts.title: How to install on Windows
posts.excerpt: Download the zip, extract, run the installer.
posts.body:
Follow these steps:

  1. Download the Windows build
  2. Extract the zip
  3. Run the installer
  4. Pair from the Android app

Need help? Email support@sendtodesk.app.
